name: Column Settings versus Filters
summary: Separate table presentation configuration from query configuration.

useWhen: distinguish column display from search criteria

content.decision: Does this setting alter what the Table displays or which records the query returns?
distinctions: Tree/Checkbox may serve column hierarchy; TreeSelect may choose filter values but does not define ownership
forbidden: Store query values in column metadata
content.guidance: Visibility, fixed position, and order belong to column settings; field enablement, operators, and defaults belong to filter configuration.
